<thought>Using the mapped reaction for template 1914395, the product is FC1CN(Cc2ccccc2)C1. Applying the template in reverse gives the alcohol precursor O[C]1CCN(CCc2ccccc2)C1. The transformation also involves a fluorinating reagent, which in the earlier step was identified as ClCCl. Therefore the possible precursor combination is the alcohol and ClCCl.</thought>
<final_answer>[[\"O[C]1CCN(CCc2ccccc2)C1\", \"ClCCl\"]]</final_answer>
